fact_text: An uptrend is a run of new higher highs, each made after price breaks the previous swing high; a downtrend is the mirror image, with new lower lows after breaking the previous low.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '3. Understanding Market Trends: Upper, Lower & Sideways Trends Explained | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-19)

fact_text: A sideways market makes neither a new high nor a new low and drifts inside a range; the analyst treats this consolidation as a no-trade zone.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '3. Understanding Market Trends: Upper, Lower & Sideways Trends Explained | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-19)

fact_text: A pullback after a high is profit-taking that briefly pushes price down; the analyst treats it as a buying opportunity in an uptrend rather than the end of the trend.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '3. Understanding Market Trends: Upper, Lower & Sideways Trends Explained | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-19)

fact_text: Many investors mistake a normal pullback for the start of a downtrend; the analyst says a healthy uptrend often resumes with a new high after the pullback, so buys belong at the pullback, not above the high.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '3. Understanding Market Trends: Upper, Lower & Sideways Trends Explained | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-19)

fact_text: The analyst's rule is to trade with the trend: in an uptrend he looks only for buy positions, and in a downtrend he looks to sell into pullbacks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '3. Understanding Market Trends: Upper, Lower & Sideways Trends Explained | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-19)

fact_text: Downtrends usually fall in a zigzag, with each rally between lower lows, rather than dropping in a straight line.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '3. Understanding Market Trends: Upper, Lower & Sideways Trends Explained | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-19)

fact_text: In a sideways range the analyst waits for price to break either the range high or the range low before a trade setup is considered.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '3. Understanding Market Trends: Upper, Lower & Sideways Trends Explained | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-19)

fact_text: As of 19 Aug 2024 the analyst described Meezan Bank as consolidating sideways after an earlier uptrend, with no new high or low, so he saw no trade until the range breaks.
source_name: Standard Capital Securities, '3. Understanding Market Trends: Upper, Lower & Sideways Trends Explained | PSX Analysis' (YouTube, 2024-08-19)

fact_text: As of 19 Aug 2024 the analyst described TRG as in a long downtrend, making successive lower lows with no sign yet of a trend reversal.
